create_VizSeqWebView: create a VizSeqWebView instance to browse and visualize NLP model evaluation results from a data root directory
get_enum_tasks_and_names_and_enum_models: enumerate all tasks and their associated models from a VizSeq data root directory
get_scores: retrieve corpus, group, and sentence-level scores for all metrics and models in a VizSeq evaluation
get_page_data_with_pagination: get paginated evaluation data with source, reference, and hypothesis texts for a task
latex_corpus_group_scores: export corpus and group-level scores to LaTeX table format for all metrics
